name: Doodle
description_en:
Doodle coordinates meeting times through several distinct tools: Group Poll collects votes on proposed times, Booking Page exposes bookable availability, 1:1 proposes choices to an individual, and Sign-up Sheet allocates sessions. The correct choice depends on whether participants are choosing one common meeting time or claiming separate places.

Its homepage also promotes Time OS as coming soon. This profile focuses on the documented scheduling tools; announced time-management concepts are not treated as already available entitlements.
description_zh:
Doodle 通过几种不同工具协调时间：Group Poll 收集候选时间投票，Booking Page 展示可预约时间，1:1 向个人提出选项，Sign-up Sheet 分配场次。应先区分参与者是在共同选择一个会议时间，还是分别领取场次名额。

首页还宣传即将推出的 Time OS。本文重点介绍有文档的排程工具，不把已宣布的时间管理概念当作已开放权益。

core_features.explanation_en: Offer candidate time slots and collect participant responses before choosing a final option.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提供候选时段，收集回应后选择最终时间。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate tools support availability booking and session choice.
core_features.explanation_zh: 不同工具分别支持可用时间预约和场次选择。

core_features.explanation_en: Calendar-connected organizers send invitations after finalization; otherwise confirmation email requires calendar entry by users.
core_features.explanation_zh: 连接日历后定案发送邀请；未连接时通过邮件确认，由用户添加日历。

sections.title_en: Example: find one time across organizations
sections.title_zh: 示例：跨组织确定一个会议时间
sections.en:
Create a Group Poll with a title, location and several candidate times. Check the organizer time zone; the documentation says participants see times adjusted to their own zones. Share the link and wait for votes, then select one option and use Book it. A poll with responses is not yet a finalized meeting.

The creation guide limits custom durations to five minutes through twelve hours and says an event cannot span two calendar dates; use the all-day option where appropriate. It separately permits up to 1,000 respondents. That participant ceiling must not be confused with the number of proposed time slots.
sections.zh:
创建 Group Poll，填写标题、地点及多个候选时间。检查组织者时区；文档表示参与者按自己的时区查看时间。分享链接、等待投票，然后选定一个选项并使用 Book it。有投票回应，不代表会议已定案。

创建指南把自定义时长限制为五分钟至十二小时，并表示事件不能跨越两个日历日期，适当时可用全天选项；另行允许最多 1,000 位回应者。参与人数上限不能混同候选时段数量。

sections.en:
Only one final option can be selected. With a connected calendar, Doodle sends calendar invitations to poll participants, including those who did not vote for the chosen time; people who never participated receive no invitation. Without a connected calendar, Doodle sends confirmation email and users add the event to their calendars themselves.

An organizer should therefore review attendance separately from availability votes. If someone did not respond but must attend, do not assume finalization enrolled that person. Check the final participant list and saved calendar event before sending a second invitation.
sections.zh:
最终只能选择一个选项。连接日历时，Doodle 向投票参与者发送日历邀请，包括未投所选时段的人；从未参与的人不会收到邀请。没有连接日历时，Doodle 发送确认邮件，由用户自行添加日历。

因此，组织者应把出席安排与可用性投票分开核对。某人必须出席却未回应时，不能认定定案自动纳入了此人。发送第二次邀请前，应核对最终参与者名单及保存的日历事件。

sections.en:
The current Free card lists one Group Poll, one Booking Page, one 1:1 and three basic Sign-up Sheets. The detailed comparison elsewhere says unlimited Sign-up Sheets, so that discrepancy needs account confirmation. The help guide clearly limits a Free account to one Group Poll, with up to ten proposed time slots; Professional supports up to 1,000 slots.

Deadlines, automatic reminders and hidden participant lists require a Professional plan according to the guide. Pro/Team are seat subscriptions with monthly/yearly controls, but their numeric amounts are not reliably exposed in the read pricing text and are left unknown. Enterprise shows a USD 15,000 annual starting point with custom conditions. Do not infer a final team total or promotion from an incomplete dynamic price.
sections.zh:
当前 Free 卡片列出一个 Group Poll、一个 Booking Page、一个 1:1 和三个基础 Sign-up Sheet；其他详细比较位置却写报名表不限，需要账户确认这一差异。帮助指南明确 Free 账户只能创建一个 Group Poll，最多十个候选时段；Professional 最多 1,000 个候选时段。

指南表示截止日期、自动提醒及隐藏参与者名单需 Professional。Pro/Team 按席位订阅，分月付/年付，但读取的动态定价文本未可靠显示其金额，本文保留未知。Enterprise 列出每年 USD 15,000 起并有定制条件。不能从不完整动态价格推定最终团队总额或促销。

sections.title_en: Choose the interaction, then verify account behavior
sections.title_zh: 先选交互方式，再核实账户行为
sections.en:
Group voting suits organizers who cannot assume access to everyone’s calendar. A regular customer booking link is better evaluated through Booking Page; a session roster needs Sign-up Sheet semantics. Do not use poll finalization as a replacement for a ticket basket or automatically scheduled recurring series without confirming those requirements.

Prepare the calendar account, meeting location, time zones and privacy policy before sharing a poll. The read sources describe a managed service. No self-hosting licence, data-export completeness, conferencing failure handling or new Time OS deployment was verified. The guide is sufficient for a documentation scenario, not an independently tested reliability claim.
sections.zh:
无法假定能读取所有人日历的组织者，适合评估群组投票。常规客户预约链接应看 Booking Page，场次名单则需评估 Sign-up Sheet 的规则。未确认要求前，不应把投票定案当作票务购物篮或自动重复系列会议的替代。

分享投票前，应准备日历账户、会议地点、时区及隐私政策。已读来源介绍托管服务；未核实自托管许可、数据导出完整性、会议工具失败处理或新 Time OS 的部署。指南足以设计文档示例，不能当作独立可靠性实测。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Pro/Team numeric checkout prices and the Free Sign-up Sheet count discrepancy need confirmation; no signup or poll was executed.
research_gaps.zh: Pro/Team 实际金额及 Free 报名表数量矛盾需确认；未注册或实际创建投票。

research_gaps.en: Time OS is announced as coming soon; rollout, licence, retention and integration recovery were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: Time OS 宣布即将推出，未核实开放范围、许可、保留及集成恢复。
